actions.description: The action the client wants to allow for the specified principal. e.g. [AwsSqsActionType.SEND_MESSAGE, AwsSqsActionType.RECEIVE_MESSAGE]

accountIds.description: The AWS account number of the principal who is given permission. e.g. [850572971111, 650572971112]

label.description: The unique identification of the permission you're setting. e.g. AliceSendMessage

title: This type provides an interface to the AWS *Simple Queue Permission*;
name: AwsSqsPermission
